remarks: This wonderful 2/3 BEDROOM, 2.5-bathroom townhouse is the epitome of modern living. Gleaming hardwood floors and freshly painted throughout, this townhouse is ready to be a home. The main floor has a large living room with fireplace and sliders to the balcony, a kitchen and a dining room. A powder room and laundry closet are great extras too. Upstairs, there is generous primary suite with vaulted ceiling and a recently renovated en-suite bathroom and two large closets. Across the hallway is an additional bedroom AND ANOTHER BONUS ROOM, offering the option of a 3rd bedroom/home office/flex spaces. A full bath completes this floor. Outside, the boxes continue to be ticked off the wish list with a coveted carport and a storage room. Microwave, Fridge, Cven and Air Handler all from 2019. What more could you want? And all of this within walking distance of shopping, dining and all the buzz of the ever vibrant downtown. Move right in! Begin to view 6/25.
